units: <cite ref="Shabbat 20b:6">Sabb. 20ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="L00558"><he>לכש</he></cite>, <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">ib. II, 1</cite>) <he>ש׳ דארזא</he> the bark of a cedar tree.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 2:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ דארזא עץ וכ׳</he> but the bark of cedar is mere wood (and cannot be used as a wick)! Answ. <he>בעמרניתא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00935"><he>עַמְרָנִיתָא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="U00350"><he>שַׂוְוכָּא</he></cite>.
